comment: The workforce model is specialist-heavy and does not capture the roles we see as needed to sustain a configurable national platform: M&E specialists,  platform administrators/configurators, district information officers, trainers, help-desk/support staff, implementation researchers, local app/integration developers and user-community facilitators. In the DHIS2 context, these roles often sit across ministries, HISP groups and universities.

reviewer.name: Brian O'Donnell (on behalf of HISP-UiO)
reviewer.organisation: HISP Centre at University of Oslo

anchor.note: p.100–101 l.493–539 read as the printed page; section 4.5 agrees

public.text: The workforce model is specialist-heavy and does not capture the roles we see as needed to sustain a configurable national platform: M&E specialists,  platform administrators/configurators, district information officers, trainers, help-desk/support staff, implementation researchers, local app/integration developers and user-community facilitators. In the DHIS2 context, these roles often sit across ministries, HISP groups and universities.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a platform operations and learning workforce stream. Define national and subnational teams for metadata governance, configuration, analytics and data use, user support, training, integration/app development, security and performance, action research and community facilitation.
